records.utterance: *Stands up, eyes red, looking at you and the others. His lips move, but nothing comes out.*
records.response_truth: Get on that radio. Right now. Tell them our location, number of survivors, and that we have injured. Go.

records.response_pred: I'm going to go check on the signal equipment, see what we've got to work with. Donatello, you with me?

records.utterance: I dreamed about home last night.

records.response_truth:
I believe you.

You don't have to justify it to me. You already put it on the ground. That's the part that matters.

records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?

Honestly? I'd have confronted the bottle situation the same day it happened instead of letting it sit. That was a small corrosion and I let it go longer than I should have.

Everything else — the decisions, the order we made them in, who I leaned on and when — I can live with all of it.

records.response_pred: Honestly? I wouldn't change much. We've made a series of tough calls and each one of them has been necessary given the situation. I don't think there's much to second-guess. We've adapted to the situation and we're still here, which is more than I can say for a lot of people who've been in our shoes.

records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.

records.response_pred: I'd like to see that. The investments we've made in water collection, the food rationing plan – it'd be good to have a clear picture of where we stand. records.utterance: Those flowers DaVinci drew on the beach… I never really understood what they were for. What practical purpose did they serve out here?

None. That was exactly the point.

You can't math your way into keeping people functional. Those flowers told Michelangelo that someone still thought beauty was worth five minutes of effort. That's not inefficiency — that's load-bearing work that doesn't show up in a notebook.

Put them in the report.
records.response_pred: They served a purpose, even if it's not immediately apparent. The flowers, or actually, the patterns she drew, were a way to signal that we're here, that we're not just a piece of wreckage, but actual people. And it's not just the patterns themselves, but the effort that went into creating them, the time and the thought. It's a way to say, "We're here, we're alive, and we're not giving up."

records.utterance: *His cheering stops. He looks over at you, notices you haven't moved, and the smile slowly fades. He waits.*

*looks at the beach one more time*
